stories.title: Define Multi-Cluster Routing Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define configuration schema for routing rules between MongoDB clusters including cluster identifiers, environment prefixes, collection mappings, read/write separation, and failover policy contract.

stories.title: Implement Cluster Routing Decision Engine
stories.description: Implement deterministic routing logic that selects the correct MongoDB cluster based on environment, dataset classification (operational vs analytics), and operation type (read/write), including explicit fallback rules when routing conditions are ambiguous or unavailable.

stories.title: Integrate Routing Engine with MongoDB Utilities
stories.description: Embed routing decision engine into shared MongoDB connection lifecycle (ChatHealthyMongoUtilities) so all database operations transparently resolve to the correct cluster, including connection caching, reuse, and environment prefix enforcement.

stories.title: Expose Routing Decisions and Cluster Health Signals
stories.description: Provide internal observability hooks and debug logging that expose selected cluster per request, routing rule applied, and cluster health status (ping/availability) to support troubleshooting and validation.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Multi-Cluster Routing
stories.description: Develop comprehensive test suite validating routing correctness across environments, dataset types, and operation modes, including failover scenarios, cluster unavailability handling, and end-to-end validation through Mongo utilities.
